name: Growth {OS}

group.label: 04 · GROW
group.purpose: Turn value into distribution and revenue

tagline: Loops, experiments and the channels that compound.

commands.name: /growth
commands.does: Opens the growth view: live loops, running experiments and the top of the backlog.
commands.returns: Running experiments first, with any unregistered threshold flagged before anything else.

commands.name: /loop-map
commands.does: Maps the business's loops and separates them from funnels wearing the name.
commands.returns: Each loop with cycle time, coefficient and cost; non-closing candidates listed as funnels with the failing step.

commands.name: /loop-audit
commands.does: Walks one loop step by step and ranks steps by effect on cycle time and coefficient.
commands.returns: The weakest step, its effect size, and the data behind the ranking.

commands.name: /hypothesis
commands.does: Turns an observation into a falsifiable hypothesis tied to a loop step.
commands.returns: Mechanism, expected effect size and the cheapest test that could falsify it.

commands.name: /backlog
commands.does: Ranks the experiment backlog by information gained per unit of cost and time.
commands.returns: The ranked list with a stated ranking reason per entry.

commands.name: /experiment-design
commands.does: Fixes target metric, guardrail metric, sample, duration, success threshold and stopping rule.
commands.returns: A pre-registered design that becomes immutable once the experiment runs.

commands.name: /experiment-run
commands.does: Registers the experiment as running and produces the change proposal for its owning OS.
commands.returns: The running record, the change proposal, and the OS that must apply it under its own gate.

commands.name: /experiment-read
commands.does: Reads a stopped experiment against the threshold fixed beforehand.
commands.returns: A verdict with both target and guardrail movements, or an underpowered report and no verdict.

commands.name: /channel-economics
commands.does: Scores a channel on acquisition cost against the revenue its cohorts actually retained.
commands.returns: Cost per retained cohort, flagged provisional while the retention window is open.

commands.name: /scale
commands.does: Proposes scaling a channel to its owning OS with a spend ceiling attached.
commands.returns: A scale proposal requiring human approval before any spend.

commands.name: /kill
commands.does: Records the decision to stop a channel and the economics behind it.
commands.returns: A kill record durable enough to answer the next person who wants to retry the channel.

commands.name: /growth-review
commands.does: Reviews loops, running experiments and channel economics on the operator's cadence.
commands.returns: What compounds, what leaks, what should stop, and which backlog entries are now obsolete.

requires_human_approval_for: any experiment that changes customer-facing pricing, including a temporary discount
any spend, of any size, on any channel
any experiment run on live customers where the customer is not told
any experiment whose guardrail is a trust, safety or support metric
scaling a channel beyond a spend ceiling the operator previously set
